metadata.speakText: Across Alderbrook a little station waited beneath a pale autumn sky. The baker in Alderbrook opened his door and watched the silver mist rise.
Across Alderbrook a little station waited beneath a pale autumn sky. The baker in Alderbrook opened his door and watched the silver mist rise.
In Alderbrook the lantern burned beside the garden gate at dawn. A narrow path through Alderbrook curved among tall trees toward a quiet house.
